The bridge names TIMEOUT, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and INVALID_RESPONSE as its own transport codes instead of importing ErrorCode from @agiworkforce/types, so a renderer maps a host failure onto a code the server never uses.
entries.fix: Import ErrorCode and raise its members; add a transport class to the shared taxonomy if none of them fits.

entries.why: The retry table matches PGRST116, NETWORK_ERROR and PAYMENT_REQUIRED as string literals rather than reading the shared error codes, so a code the server renames is retried under the old spelling forever.
entries.fix: Read ErrorCode and the retry disposition from the shared taxonomy instead of matching literals.

entries.why: The unavailable screen restates entitlement, permission and policy to choose its copy, so a fourth control layer added to the registry renders the wrong sentence on mobile.
entries.fix: Import CONTROL_LAYERS and key the copy off it.

entries.why: The admin panel restates imageInput, reasoning, imageOutput and videoOutput to label route economics, so a capability added to the catalogue is missing from the panel with no failure.
entries.fix: Read the capability names from COMPAT_CAPABILITY_SOURCES.
